summary.en: One-sided headaches four to five times a month with light sensitivity; migraine. Naxdom 500 at the start of pain, at most two a day, and Ciplar 10 every night for a month to prevent attacks. Sleep well, do not skip meals, keep a headache diary, review in a month.

instructions.text: Naxdom 500 not more than two a day
Get enough sleep, do not skip meals, keep a headache diary
